method: built-in image generation plus deterministic local code animation
payment_policy: No paid API, subscription, credit purchase or payment prompt is authorized.

motion_language.hero_action_rule: One prioritized character action per shot.
motion_language.easing: ease-in-out for pose travel; ease-out-back only for small celebratory landings
motion_language.camera_rule: One camera move per beat; use push, follow or parallax, never stack all three.
motion_language.editing_rule: Cut on action and align major pose landings to the original song beat grid.
